import pandas as pd
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

annual = pd.DataFrame(datasets["7ff2ea95c78b26f175ed266b27038426"]).iloc[0]
region = pd.DataFrame(datasets["ed032d73cc952455717d290174381457"]).set_index("territory_label")
category = pd.DataFrame(datasets["68d8f2adb1265c0d51f8816cef8e3df6"]).set_index("category_name")
repeat = pd.DataFrame(datasets["603996d04147e4c98243bc2a977af2e3"]).iloc[0]
recon = pd.DataFrame(datasets["34c072de7d2378a4241b83b9f496e7ff"]).set_index("order_year")
naive = pd.DataFrame(datasets["9542504060b4aa0b839c0f7d6b05d520"]).set_index("order_year")
complete = pd.DataFrame(datasets["60b57b43a3ba173894bd8f01d175e7b3"]).iloc[0]
cat_audit = pd.DataFrame(datasets["39c377126214ef22a29c5b1bea58699c"]).set_index("order_year")
valid = pd.DataFrame(datasets["68d5108d1c1419ea0dda784e9048616b"]).set_index("order_year")

def money(value):
    return f"{Decimal(str(value)).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP):,.2f}"

def signed_money(value):
    d = Decimal(str(value)).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    return f"+{d:,.2f}" if d > 0 else f"{d:,.2f}"

def integer(value):
    return f"{int(value):,}"

def signed_integer(value):
    value = int(value)
    return f"+{value:,}" if value > 0 else f"{value:,}"

def pct(value):
    return f"{Decimal(str(value * 100)).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP):+.2f}%"

def pp(value):
    return f"{Decimal(str(value)).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP):+.2f} 个百分点"

def share_pct_text(value):
    return f"{Decimal(str(value * 100)).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP):+.2f}%"

def money_unsign(value):
    return money(value)

def growth_text(value):
    return "不可计算（无基期行金额）" if pd.isna(value) else pct(value)

def small_money(value):
    return f"{Decimal(str(value)).quantize(Decimal('0.0000000001'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP):.10f}"

def cat_cell(name, year_col):
    val = category.loc[name, year_col]
    return "0.00" if pd.isna(val) else money(val)

bikes = category.loc["Bikes"]
accessories = category.loc["Accessories"]
clothing = category.loc["Clothing"]
total_row = category.loc["全部产品大类"]
unclassified = category.loc["未分类产品（核验）"]
au = region.loc["Australia [9]"]
uk = region.loc["United Kingdom [10]"]
de = region.loc["Germany [8]"]
fr = region.loc["France [7]"]
sw = region.loc["Southwest [4]"]
ca = region.loc["Canada [6]"]

vals = {
    "year_2002_text": "2002",
    "year_2003_text": "2003",
    "orders_2002_text": integer(annual["orders_2002"]),
    "orders_2003_text": integer(annual["orders_2003"]),
    "order_delta_text": signed_integer(annual["order_delta"]),
    "order_growth_text": pct(annual["order_growth_rate"]),
    "revenue_2002_text": money(annual["revenue_2002"]),
    "revenue_2003_text": money(annual["revenue_2003"]),
    "revenue_delta_text": signed_money(annual["revenue_delta"]),
    "revenue_growth_text": pct(annual["revenue_growth_rate"]),
    "aov_2002_text": money(annual["aov_2002"]),
    "aov_2003_text": money(annual["aov_2003"]),
    "aov_delta_text": signed_money(annual["aov_delta"]),
    "aov_growth_text": pct(annual["aov_growth_rate"]),
    "au_delta_text": signed_money(au["revenue_delta_2003_minus_2002"]),
    "au_share_text": share_pct_text(au["revenue_delta_share"]),
    "uk_delta_text": signed_money(uk["revenue_delta_2003_minus_2002"]),
    "uk_share_text": share_pct_text(uk["revenue_delta_share"]),
    "de_delta_text": signed_money(de["revenue_delta_2003_minus_2002"]),
    "de_share_text": share_pct_text(de["revenue_delta_share"]),
    "fr_delta_text": signed_money(fr["revenue_delta_2003_minus_2002"]),
    "fr_share_text": share_pct_text(fr["revenue_delta_share"]),
    "sw_delta_text": signed_money(sw["revenue_delta_2003_minus_2002"]),
    "sw_share_text": share_pct_text(sw["revenue_delta_share"]),
    "ca_delta_text": signed_money(ca["revenue_delta_2003_minus_2002"]),
    "ca_share_text": share_pct_text(ca["revenue_delta_share"]),
    "bikes_2002_text": cat_cell("Bikes", "line_total_2002"),
    "bikes_2003_text": cat_cell("Bikes", "line_total_2003"),
    "bikes_delta_text": signed_money(bikes["line_total_delta_2003_minus_2002"]),
    "bikes_growth_text": growth_text(bikes["line_total_growth_rate"]),
    "bikes_share_text": share_pct_text(bikes["line_total_delta_share"]),
    "accessories_2002_text": cat_cell("Accessories", "line_total_2002"),
    "accessories_2003_text": cat_cell("Accessories", "line_total_2003"),
    "accessories_delta_text": signed_money(accessories["line_total_delta_2003_minus_2002"]),
    "accessories_growth_text": growth_text(accessories["line_total_growth_rate"]),
    "accessories_share_text": share_pct_text(accessories["line_total_delta_share"]),
    "clothing_2002_text": cat_cell("Clothing", "line_total_2002"),
    "clothing_2003_text": cat_cell("Clothing", "line_total_2003"),
    "clothing_delta_text": signed_money(clothing["line_total_delta_2003_minus_2002"]),
    "clothing_growth_text": growth_text(clothing["line_total_growth_rate"]),
    "clothing_share_text": share_pct_text(clothing["line_total_delta_share"]),
    "category_total_2002_text": money(total_row["line_total_2002"]),
    "category_total_2003_text": money(total_row["line_total_2003"]),
    "category_total_delta_text": signed_money(total_row["line_total_delta_2003_minus_2002"]),
    "category_total_growth_text": pct(total_row["line_total_growth_rate"]),
    "category_total_share_text": share_pct_text(total_row["line_total_delta_share"]),
    "unclassified_2002_text": "0.00",
    "unclassified_2003_text": "0.00",
    "unclassified_delta_text": "0.00",
    "unclassified_growth_text": "不可计算（无基期行金额）",
    "unclassified_share_text": "0.00%",
    "recon_2002_diff_text": small_money(recon.loc[2002, "header_minus_line"]),
    "recon_2003_diff_text": small_money(recon.loc[2003, "header_minus_line"]),
    "naive_2002_delta_text": money(naive.loc[2002, "naive_duplication_delta"]),
    "naive_2003_delta_text": money(naive.loc[2003, "naive_duplication_delta"]),
    "header_2003_text": money(recon.loc[2003, "header_subtotal"]),
    "line_2003_text": money(recon.loc[2003, "line_total"]),
    "detail_rows_2003_text": integer(recon.loc[2003, "detail_rows"]),
    "valid_orders_without_detail_text": integer(complete["valid_orders_without_detail"]),
    "detail_without_header_text": integer(complete["detail_rows_without_header"]),
    "detail_outside_scope_text": integer(complete["detail_rows_outside_valid_scope"]),
    "unknown_territory_orders_2002_text": integer(valid.loc[2002, "orders_unknown_territory"]),
    "unknown_territory_orders_2003_text": integer(valid.loc[2003, "orders_unknown_territory"]),
    "unknown_customer_orders_2002_text": integer(valid.loc[2002, "orders_unknown_customer"]),
    "unknown_customer_orders_2003_text": integer(valid.loc[2003, "orders_unknown_customer"]),
    "unclassified_rows_2002_text": integer(cat_audit.loc[2002, "unclassified_rows"]),
    "unclassified_rows_2003_text": integer(cat_audit.loc[2003, "unclassified_rows"]),
    "unclassified_amount_2002_text": money(cat_audit.loc[2002, "unclassified_line_total"]),
    "unclassified_amount_2003_text": money(cat_audit.loc[2003, "unclassified_line_total"]),
    "customers_2002_text": integer(repeat["customers_2002"]),
    "repeat_customers_2002_text": integer(repeat["repeat_customers_2002"]),
    "repeat_rate_2002_text": f"{Decimal(str(repeat['repeat_rate_2002'] * 100)).quantize(Decimal('0.01')):.2f}%",
    "customers_2003_text": integer(repeat["customers_2003"]),
    "repeat_customers_2003_text": integer(repeat["repeat_customers_2003"]),
    "repeat_rate_2003_text": f"{Decimal(str(repeat['repeat_rate_2003'] * 100)).quantize(Decimal('0.01')):.2f}%",
    "repeat_customer_delta_text": signed_integer(repeat["repeat_customer_delta"]),
    "repeat_rate_delta_text": pp(repeat["repeat_rate_delta_pp"]),
}
result = pd.DataFrame([vals])
